title: CellChatESS: Expression-Supported Streaming for efficient CellChat inference
description: CellChatESS implements Expression-Supported Streaming (ESS), an Rcpp acceleration method for triMean-based CellChat RNA workflows. ESS projects expression data to genes used by ligand-receptor, complex and cofactor calculations, evaluates sender-receiver pairs from observed expression support and streams bootstrap summaries while preserving the CellChat probability model and object interface.
